newsitem.title: UK: FKI says trading still favourable in Q1.
newsitem.headline: FKI says trading still favourable in Q1.

text.p: British engineering group FKI Plc said on Tuesday overall trading conditions in the first quarter of the financial year remained favourable and provided "substantial opportunities" for continued growth.

"The further strengthening of sterling will affect earnings growth although, to date, any impact has been on the translation of overseas earnings rather than on the intake of new orders which, during the year to date, have continued to be received at planned rate," the company told the annual general meeting.
The company said it was making good progress on reorganising the Hawker Siddeley Electric Power Group.
Also, it said its recent agreed 131 million stg bid for wire rope and lifting systems maker Bridon Plc "provides an exciting opportunity for strengthening further our material handling division."
